author: Separate isolated AI author with generic brief, domain-diversity constraint, distractors and nested-reply requirement. No old story, implementation, research prompt, private records or current conversation.
researcher: Fresh isolated AI session with scope and fixed synthetic MCP only. No hidden rubric.
stop: One substantive attempt, 45 charged source calls, 80 requests or 15 minutes. Final receipt required; no retuning or hints after story observation.
changes: Observed open branches ranked deepest first; AI chooses requests and explains deviations.
Subject-authored full-read audit calls out diagnosis, ruling out causes, proposed fixes and follow-through in the final narrative.
Roles select evidence indices inside a claim; code derives role-record-claim links.
Used-record dispositions derive from citations; uncited full records require an explicit model explanation.
Checked attachment ledger derives only from actual receipts.
hypotheses: Material nested replies are inspected before peripheral standalone work consumes the budget.
Personal diagnostic contributions survive in final prose, not only tables.
Every full read has exactly one mechanically consistent disposition; unsupported or missing semantic explanations still fail.
failure_criteria: Relevant accessible context remains unnoticed or is misinterpreted.
Invented/mismatched span ID or unsupported claim.
Narrative contradicts authoritative stopping counts or silently loses material attribution.
assessment: Original-source/manual hidden-rubric assessment after first run; separate structural and semantic outcomes.
comparison_limit: New story, prioritisation prompt, observed queues and output schema changed together; no causal benchmark claim.
